rationale: C25 is a direct and material drafting template for the child letter. Both concern the same Ukraine national-emergency lineage and use the same sequence: report the order, identify the territorial target, enumerate prohibitions on new investment, imports, exports/reexports/sales/supply, and facilitation, then enumerate designation criteria for persons operating in the region, leaders of entities there, persons owned or controlled by blocked persons, and material supporters. The child primarily substitutes the DNR/LNR and other Covered Regions for Crimea and adds limited temporal and office-title detail. C13 is the underlying executive-order version of substantially the same machinery, while C12 has a similar trade-and-investment sanctions package but is less directly matched.

shared_material.child_excerpt: prohibiting new investment in the so-called DNR or LNR regions of Ukraine ... by a United States person, wherever located; the importation into the United States, directly or indirectly, of any goods, services, or technology from the Covered Regions; the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply, directly or indirectly, from the United States, or by a United States person, wherever located
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The order prohibits new investment by United States persons in the Crimea region of Ukraine; the importation of goods, services, or technology into the United States from the Crimea region of Ukraine; and the exportation, reexportation, sale, or supply of goods, services, or technology from the United States or by a United States person to the Crimea region of Ukraine.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reproduces C25's distinctive three-part investment, import, and export prohibition sequence while replacing Crimea with the Covered Regions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: any approval, financing, facilitation, or guarantee by a United States person, wherever located, of a transaction by a foreign person where the transaction by that foreign person would be prohibited by the order if performed by a United States person or within the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It also prohibits the facilitation of any such transactions.
shared_material.explanation: The child expands C25's summarized facilitation prohibition into the standard operative formulation while retaining the same position and function in the sanctions package.

shared_material.child_excerpt: persons determined to operate or have operated since the date of the order in the Covered Regions; to be or have been since the date of the order a leader, official, senior executive officer, or member of the board of directors of an entity operating in the Covered Region; to be owned or controlled by ... any person whose property and interests in property are blocked ...; or to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material, or technological support for ... any person whose property and interests in property are blocked
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to operate in the Crimea region of Ukraine; to be a leader of an entity operating in the Crimea region of Ukraine; to be owned or controlled by, or to have acted or purported to act for or on behalf of ... any person whose property and interests in property are blocked ...; or to have materially assisted, sponsored, or provided financial, material, or technological support for, or goods or services to or in support of, any person whose property and interests in property are blocked
shared_material.explanation: The four designation grounds appear in essentially the same order and language, with the child adding temporal qualifications and additional leadership roles.
